deadline.value: Priority Fall deadline for funding consideration is January 2, 2027; final Fall deadline is April 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: Deadlines: January 2 (priority deadline for funding consideration) and April 1 (final) for fall; September 1 (priority deadline for the Environmental Biology track), October 1 (priority deadline for the Molecular, Cellular and Organismal Biology track), or November 1 (final deadline for both tracks) for spring

gre_general.value: Submission of GRE General Test scores is optional for Biology PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: Optional: Submissions of scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Combined Aptitude Test

gre_subject.value: ETS discontinued the Biology GRE Subject Test; GRE General Test submission is optional.
gre_subject.quote: Optional: Submissions of scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) Combined Aptitude Test

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A prospective student's stated research interests must coincide to an acceptable degree with the specialties of faculty in the program.
supervisor.quote: The stated interests of a prospective student must coincide to an acceptable degree with the faculty specialties represented in the program.

funding.value: Apply by the January 2 priority deadline for funding consideration; PhD students serve as teaching assistants for at least two semesters and are eligible for TA/RA appointments ($25,865 stipend + 100% tuition waiver for 1.0 FTE in AY 2026-27).
funding.quote: Deadlines: January 2 (priority deadline for funding consideration) and April 1 (final) for fall | Teaching: Students are required to participate in the teaching program as teaching assistants for at least two semesters.

also.quote: These positions are assigned by the student's department/program and are subject to the agreement between UMass Boston and UAW/Graduate Employees Organization (GEO). | Full Assistantship | 18.00 | 1.00 | $1,293.25 | $25,865.00 | 100%

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold at least a bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution and submit transcripts of all undergraduate and graduate work; up to 6 graduate credits may transfer toward the 60-credit PhD.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree, or its equivalent, from a 4-year college or university of recognized standing | Official transcripts of all graduate and undergraduate work. | Residency: No more than six credits from another graduate program may be applied toward the program.

notes: Offers tracks in Environmental Biology and in Molecular, Cellular, and Organismal Biology (MCOB).
